system.description:
| Dust Veil – Unstable / [Physical], [Elemental] / An Unstable creature that moves more than 10 feet before the end of their next turn falls prone. / An Unstable creature suffers disadvantage on saving throws to resist being moved against its will or knocked Prone. / An Unstable creature reduces the damage they deal with melee attacks by 4. |

You can manipulate particles of soft and light sand. While your Dust Veil is active, your sand passively tries to protect you granting you bonus DR equal to your highest Ability modifier against attack-based damage.

Potency I: While in this stance, creatures that take damage from a Jiton Hijutsu you cast, they become Unstable.

Potency II: As a Bonus action, you can manifest constructs made entirely of sand. When you complete a rest, select one jutsu from the following list. You can cast the chosen jutsu as part of this Bonus Action, as if you were casting it at A-Rank, at no chakra cost. If the jutsu would allow you to summon more than one creature as part of its casting, you can summon no more than two of those creatures. Once you use this effect, you cannot do so again until you complete a rest.

Beast Imitating Art: Predator

Sealing Art: Inanimate Puppet

Beast Imitating Art: Oni Twins

Earth Release: Mud Wolf

Earth Release: Stone Dragon
